messages.subject: [Diagnosismed-list] Notice to Appear
messages.body_plain:
Notice to Appear,

This is to inform you to appear in the Court on the March 01 for your case hearing.
Please, prepare all the documents relating to the case and bring them to Court on the specified date.
Note: If you do not come, the case will be heard in your absence.

The Court Notice is attached to this email.

Yours faithfully,
Danny Bowling,
Court Secretary.
